note: Linn County Conservation Board park on the SE side of Marion, Hwy 13 and Hwy 100 (formerly Squaw Creek Park). Trails through meadow, creek bottom and timber. --Claude
summary: Changed nothing on rates ($30-35 confirmed, split explained: no-sewer A sites and B Loop $30). Added season Apr 15-Oct 15, 14-in-21 limit, water, 35-ft pads. Pin good.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (up, weak): stored 'not waterfront' holds for most of the park, but imagery shows a small creek ~45-70 m west of the B Loop's northern arms, about 42.0150,-91.5650, across unused open grass and brush with no road between. Beyond the ~50-m apron bound or at its edge, canopy-free but the channel is a few metres wide, low in its bed, and no official photo shows it from a site. The note's 'Cedar River is a couple miles off' was true of the river and said nothing of this creek; dropped. I read this as not waterfront, staying down.

FCFS/B Loop: the park page calls only A Loop reservable, but Facility 'Campsite-Wanatee-Park-B-01' has its own booking page at $30 with 'Fridays and Saturdays must be booked together'. Only B-01 shows among B Loop sites. The county may be moving B Loop online. I kept fcfs some_sites and didn't record a weekend minimum since A Loop's pages read don't carry it. Linn County's own site answered 403 to the A Loop map PDF (linncounty.org DocumentCenter/View/15023), unread as you warned.

Pin 42.01415,-91.56155 is mid-campground between the two loops; no change. Phone 319-892-6450 confirmed. Website is MyCountyParks; the county's official page linncountyiowa.gov/conservation refuses plain HTTP, so unread.
Sewer isn't at every A Loop site: A-14 'This site does not have sewer'; A-14, 15, 17 and 19 are $30. Old note's blanket 'A Loop full hookup' is removed.
